# Does your dog have cancer? Don't lose heart

  * ### Does your dog have cancer? Don't lose heart

Image

Jun 24,2015 Posted By : Santosh Andhale

Tata Memorial Centre in Kharghar offers chemotherapy and radiotherapy for canines; it's the only such unit in the country

Image: Dog Cancer

###### Snowy (left) is undergoing radiation for oral cancer; canine activist Shwetali Mulik, who had taken her Labrador to the Kharghar facility, has been creating awareness

 

Angela Mah's face beamed with joy when she saw her dog Snowy responding to treatment. It was Snowy's sixth radiation session. You heard it right. The dog was receiving cancer care.

In what could bring a smile on the face of hundreds of dog owners, cancer-afflicted canines can be treated at the the Advanced Centre for Treatment, Research & Education in Cancer (ACTREC), Tata Memorial Centre, at Kharghar in Navi Mumbai. It is the only such facility in the country.

Experts say cancer afflicts a large number dogs and majority of them die untreated as most of city veterinary doctors are unaware of the availability of treatment in India.

Singaporean Angela, employed with a multinational firm, shifted base to Mumbai last year and brought Snowy with her. Three months ago, she notice a small growth on the left side of the dog's neck. Angela was devastated when tests revealed that Snowy had oral cancer.

After spending some sleepless nights, she came across a vet who advised her to consult Dr Pradip Chaudhari, a veterinary oncologist at ACTREC. "Initially, I didn't know what to do. It seems many vets are clueless about the availability of radiation therapy here. In the absence of awareness, I believe, many pet owners watch with pain their beloved pets losing the battle," said Angela.

The 47-year-old executive said the radiation cycles have helped Snowy in many ways in the past six weeks. "Earlier, she wouldn't eat properly, which is not the case now. Her treatment is still on and I'm hoping for the best."

Cancer care for dogs at ACTREC costs between Rs40,000 and Rs60,000 depending on treatment cycles such as chemotherapy or radiation. Last year, the centre treated nearly 150 dogs.

Citing medical data, an expert said dogs receiving radiation treatment live for over two years. For lack of awareness, several owners live with a sense of guilt about not being able to get their dogs treated. In fact, many vets advise people to put their animals to sleep.

Dr Pradip Chaudhari said, "Most people are not aware that cancers or tumours are common in dogs. There are different types of cancers in dogs which we treat in the hospital. Last year, nearly 50 dogs underwent chemotherapy and the results have been encouraging. Like humans, dogs too can be treated with radiotherapy. Careful planning minimises radiation damage to surrounding healthy tissues. Sometimes, we advise removal of tumours through surgery following which we start our treatment."

Canine activist Shwetali Mulik, who also runs a homestay facility for dogs, has been letting people know about ACTREC ever since she took her black Labrador, Lui, to the Kharghar facility in 2011. "I too was overwhelmed by a deep sense of despair until I was told about ACTREC by senior vet Dr Jairam Ramani. After the treatment, Lui survived till 2013."

#### Oncology

Compassionate Care in the Fight Against Cancer

Cancer can affect pets at any stage of life, presenting in many forms and often progressing silently before symptoms appear. Early detection and timely intervention can make a meaningful difference in treatment success and quality of life.

Our Oncology service provides comprehensive evaluation and management of cancer through advanced diagnostics and individualised treatment plans. We work closely with pet families throughout the journey, offering guidance and support at every step of care.

The department is powered by The Cancer Vet, India’s first designated veterinary oncology practice, and is led and supervised by Dr. Noopur Desai - an American-trained and board-certified oncologist,DACVR (R. Oncology).

#### Our Oncology Services Include

Oncology consultations and second opinions

Oncology consultations and second opinions

Chemotherapy and medical oncology

Radiation therapy, planned and supervised by a board-certified veterinarian and oncologist
Noopur Desai worked as an Assistant Professor of Oncology at TheOhio State University. One of the main reasons she moved back to India was to bring home what she learned over the years in the US and enhance cancer care for pets in India. Her passion lies in treating patients, training the next generation of veterinarians, and conducting clinical research. The department of Oncology brings together specialist oncologists and surgeons under the supervision of a Diplomate of the American College of Veterinary Medicine in Radiation Oncology. The team covers cancer diagnosis and staging, chemotherapy and medical oncology, surgical oncology, and supportive and palliative care.

Image: Dr. Namaeta Nadkarni

## Dr. Namaeta Nadkarni

#### BVS, MS, U.S., (Radiation & Advanced Surgery)

Dr. Namaeta Nadkarni is a veterinary surgeon with a Master's degree in Surgery from Mumbai Veterinary College and extensive clinical experience in small-animal surgical surgeries and surgeries. She has further advanced her surgical expertise in performing surgeries for many institutions, including Colorado State University and Texas State University, with a focus on minimally invasive surgery and endoscopy. Dr. Shreya is committed to advancing access to specialised oncology care for companion animals and to providing evidence-based, compassionate treatment throughout the cancer care journey.

Image: Dr. Mukta Kubde

## Dr. Mukta Kubde

#### M.V.Sc.

Dr. Mukta Kubde is a veterinary professional with a Master's degree from Mumbai Veterinary College and substantial clinical experience in small-animal practice. Her clinical expertise encompasses small-animal medicine and veterinary oncology, with a focus on comprehensive cancer care and patient-centred treatment. She brings a strong foundation in clinical case management, combining sound scientific judgment with clinical precision. The compassionate person comes from various aspects focused on developing individualised treatment approaches and supporting pets and their families throughout the cancer care process.

Image: Dr. Shubhangi Yelmule

## Dr. Shubhangi Yelmule

#### M.V.Sc.

Dr. Shubhangi Yelmule holds a Bachelor's degree from Nagpur Veterinary College and a Master's degree in Radiation Biology from Goa, Akola. She brings clinical expertise in veterinary oncology and soft tissue surgery, while also training in 24 hours per day under a 24/7 schedule. Her practice combines surgical precision, clinical judgement and comprehensive patient care, with an emphasis on delivering advanced treatment while maintaining the comfort and quality of life of companion animals throughout their care.

# Our Mission

At The Cancer Vet, our mission is to provide world-class veterinary oncology services in India, offering hope and compassionate care to pets and their families facing a cancer diagnosis. We are dedicated to advancing the field of veterinary oncology through ongoing research, education, and the development of an international residency program to train the next generation of veterinary oncologists. Our goal is to enhance the quality of life for pets battling cancer and empower pet owners with knowledge and support during this challenging journey.

# Our Values

### Hope

We believe in the power of hope. Despite the challenges a cancer diagnosis may bring, we are committed to exploring all possible treatment options and providing a beacon of hope for pets and their families.

### Compassion

We understand that pets are cherished members of the family. That's why we approach every case with deep compassion, empathy, and understanding, providing a supportive and caring environment for both pets and their owners.

At Seven Oaks Pet Hospital, we provide expert oncology services for pets in Hyderabad to diagnose and treat cancer in pets. If you suspect your pet may have cancer or if they’ve been diagnosed, contact us for expert oncology services for pets in Hyderabad. We’re here to provide the care and support your pet needs during their treatment journey.

Early detection is key. We offer comprehensive diagnostic tests, including blood work, imaging (X-rays, ultrasound), and biopsies to accurately diagnose cancer in pets.

We provide chemotherapy treatments tailored to your pet’s specific condition to slow cancer progression and improve their quality of life.

Our goal is to minimize discomfort and manage pain effectively, ensuring your pet stays as comfortable as possible during treatment.

## Nutritional Support

We offer dietary plans and supplements to help support your pet’s health during cancer treatment and improve their overall well-being.

We provide specialised palliative care and cancer-specific hospitalisation to manage symptoms, provide comfort, and support your pet’s quality of life throughout their treatment journey.

## Surgery

Our veterinary oncology team provides surgical treatment for suitable cancers, focusing on safe tumour removal and comprehensive post-operative care.

An advanced cancer treatment that combines chemotherapy with controlled electrical pulses to enhance drug delivery to tumour cells.

## Dr. Noopur Desai

BVSc, MVSc (Surgery), Diplomate ACVR (Radiation Oncology)

Image: vet

Dr. Desai is a veterinary oncologist and surgeon working out of Mumbai and is a consulting veterinary radiation oncologist for various clinics in India. 
As a boarded Veterinary Oncologist, she is one of approximately 140 board- certified veterinary specialist in Radiation Oncology worldwide and the only Diplomate in Veterinary Oncology in India. Dr. Desai graduated as a veterinarian in 2008 following which she completed her MVSc (Masters) in Surgery from Mumbai. After working as a surgeon in India, she moved to the USA to pursue an International Scholar position in Medical Oncology from Michigan State University. She then went on to complete a residency in Radiation Oncology from University of Wisconsin- Madison and achieved Diplomate status from ACVR in Radiation Oncology. Before moving back to India, she worked as an Assistant Professor in Oncology at The Ohio State University- College of Veterinary Medicine.
Her interest is on the clinic floor treating patients, teaching newer generation of veterinarians, and performing clinical research. To further this passion of teaching and providing international quality care in veterinary oncology, Dr. Desai founded “The Cancer Vet” with a goal to providing world-class education in veterinary oncology in India.
